LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 FORMATION OF ADJECTIVES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Formation of adjectives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Formation of adjectives, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How are adjectives formed from verbs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise adjectives from a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Formation of adjectives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. recognize signs of vocabulary related to adjectives formed from nouns and verbs for effective communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Formation of adjectives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. construct simple sentences using the adjectives formed

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Formation of adjectives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the value of proper use of adjectives. ● In groups, learners are guided to search for online tutorials on adjectives and examples of adjectives formed from nouns and verbs. ● In pairs, learners are guided to identify, fingerspell and sign vocabulary related to adjectives formed from nouns and verbs. ● In groups, learners are guided to observe a signed poem or passage from the teacher and pick out signs of adjectives formed from nouns and verbs. ● In pairs, learners are guided to read a given passage and identify adjectives formed from nouns and verbs. ● In pairs, learners are guided to form adjectives using nouns and verbs. ● In pairs, learners are guided to fingerspell and sign the adjectives formed using nouns and verbs. ● In pairs, learners are guided to construct simple signed sentences using the adjectives formed. ● In pairs, learners are guided to write the simple signed sentences using the adjectives formed. How are adjectives formed from verbs? 109 ● In groups, learners are guided to engage in language games such as scrabble, puzzle code words, and guessing games.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Formation of adjectives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Learner develops signing skills as they sign vocabulary related to adjectives formed from nouns and

verbs.

● Digital Literacy: Learner develops the skill of interacting with digital devices as they search and watch online tutorials on adjectives to

develop their interest in the theme.

Values:
Love: is enhanced as learners respect others opinions as they work in pairs and groups.

Link to other Subjects

The learner relates the concept of adjectives to their learning in Kiswahili.
